items.title: George Russell — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Max was with the band. He introduced me to all the bands.

ctx.x: Max was with the band. He introduced me to all the bands. This was after he had taken my place and everything. Skippy had had – I don’t want to say this, because this is unresolved, but – I’ve got to keep out of this, because this is too heavy.
Let me ask you about that song that you put different names on.
